workstreams.name: Process area requirements
workstreams.answers: What does each pharmacy process area require from a new point-of-sale system?
activities: Interview pharmacy staff on four process areas, two at once
Review operational data and documents on current practice
Consolidate requirements for sign-off at the gate

workstreams.name: Current practice gaps
workstreams.answers: Where does current practice in each process area fall short of what a new point-of-sale system requires?
activities: Compare current practice with the requirements by area
Observe daily work in pharmacies and note workarounds
Review findings with CEO, Operations Director, IT Manager

workstreams.name: Vendor shortlist and scoring
workstreams.answers: Which point-of-sale systems meet the signed-off requirements, and how do they score against them?
activities: Shortlist vendors against the signed-off requirements
Run vendor demonstrations with pharmacy staff and IT
Score each vendor against the signed-off requirements

workstreams.name: Business case for selection
workstreams.answers: Does any shortlisted point-of-sale system hold up in a business case for the selection decision?
activities: Estimate costs and benefits of each shortlisted system
Test cost assumptions against operational data
Prepare the evidence for the selection decision

workstreams.name: System setup and data load
workstreams.answers: Can the chosen system be configured for each process area and loaded with the pharmacies' data?
activities: Configure and test four process areas, two at a time
Rehearse loading pharmacy data into the configured system
Document readiness results for the workshop review

workstreams.name: Pilot pharmacy go-live
workstreams.answers: Does the configured system run stably in daily use at one pilot pharmacy?
activities: Go live at one pilot pharmacy after the readiness workshop
Track incidents and stability through daily use
Collect feedback from pilot pharmacy staff and customers

workstreams.name: Rollout, waves 1 and 2
workstreams.answers: How does the system go live in the first two waves of up to 10 pharmacies each?
activities: Train pharmacy teams before each wave goes live
Go live in two waves of up to 10 pharmacies each
Track stability and resolve issues after each go-live

workstreams.name: Rollout, waves 3 and 4
workstreams.answers: How does the system go live in the last two waves until all 40 pharmacies run it?
activities: Train pharmacy teams before each wave goes live
Go live in two waves of up to 10 pharmacies each
Confirm the system runs in all 40 pharmacies

notes: Configuration and data migration rehearsal share one stream, and rollout waves run as two paired streams, to keep four streams in Implementation.
